svg.title: How an agent uses Prancheta, and what happens inside

g.title: 1 · a request arrives: "draw me a schematic"
2 · select — what IS this content, and how must it be drawn?
3 · a preset · a composition of two · none, author raw IR
4 · the agent authors a preset input as JSON
5 · validate — the document only, in milliseconds, no browser
6 · parseFigureInput — the one dispatch CLI and MCP both reach
unknown preset — refused by name, sent back to select
7 · per-preset validators — types, ids, references, derived sums
SpecError — exact field path, near miss named, never coerced
8 · expand — a preset is a macro, not a second engine
9 · ordinary figure IR — boxes, text, connectors
10 · measure text in the same browser engine that draws it
11 · layout — ELK is handed measured sizes, never guesses
12 · checks — overlap · contrast · text fits · connectors clear
13 · repair loop — width, height, wrap, canvas padding, then measure again
15 · every check reported, every repair listed, nothing hidden
